movies.overviewAr: حين تتحول خطوبة أحد رجال شرطة الطرق السريعة المبالغ فيها من شقيقة زميله إلى فوضى، يجد الفريق نفسه بين مكائد الزميل لإفساد العلاقة ومحاولة تفكيك شبكة مخدرات جديدة، لإنقاذ الموقف وربما الزفاف أيضًا.

movies.title: The Notebook
movies.summary: Behind every great love is a great story. As teenagers, Allie (Rachel McAdams) and Noah (Ryan Gosling) begin a whirlwind courtship that soon blossoms into tender intimacy. The young couple is quickly separated by Allie's upper-class parents who insist that Noah isn't right for her. Several years pass, and when they meet again, their passion is rekindled, forcing Allie to choose between her soulmate and class order. This beautiful tale has a particularly special meaning to an older gentleman (James Garner) who regularly reads the timeless love story to his aging companion (Gena Rowlands). Based on the best-selling novel by Nicholas Sparks, The Notebook is at once heartwarming and heartbreaking and will capture you in its sweeping and emotional force.
movies.rights: © 2004 New Line Productions, Inc.
movies.plot: An elderly man reads to a woman with dementia the story of two young lovers whose romance is threatened by the difference in their respective social classes.
movies.overviewAr: تقع الفتاة (آلي) في حب الشاب (نوح) عندما يتقابلان في أحد المهرجانات، لكن عائلة الفتاة تفرق بينهما بسبب فقر نوح، لتعيش آلي بعيدًا عن حبيبها بأمرٍ من أسرتها، وتوافق في النهاية على الخطبة إلى الجندي الوسيم (لون). تشاهد آلي بالمصادفة صورة لنوح في إحدى...

movies.title: Dumb and Dumber
movies.summary: For Harry and Lloyd every day is a no-brainer. Golden Globe-winner Jim Carrey (Man on the Moon, The Truman Show) and Golden Globe-nominee Jeff Daniels (The Squid and the Whale, Speed) star as two good-natured but incredibly stupid friends who drive across the United States to return a clients briefcase in this comedy blockbuster. Also starring Lauren Holly (What Women Want, Any Given Sunday) and Academy Award-nominee Teri Garr (Tootsie, Mr. Mom).
movies.rights: © 1994 New Line Productions, Inc. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: After a woman leaves a briefcase at the airport terminal, a dumb limo driver and his dumber friend set out on a hilarious cross-country road trip to Aspen to return it.
movies.overviewAr: لويد وهاري رجلين لا يوصف غباءهما حقًا. عندما تفقد ماري ، وهي امرأة جميلة ، حقيبة مهمة بها نقود قبل أن تغادر إلى آسبن ، يقرر الصديقان (اللذان وجدا الحقيبة) إعادتها إليها. بعد بعض "المغامرات" ، وصلوا أخيرًا إلى آسبن ، حيث استخدموا الأموال الضائعة وقاتلوا من أجل قلب ماري.

movies.title: Hoodwinked
movies.summary: Little Red Riding Hood: A classic story, but there's more to every tale than meets the eye.

movies.plot: Little Red Riding Hood, the Wolf, the Woodsman and Granny all tell the police the events that led up to their encounter.
movies.overviewAr: ذات الرداء الأحمر: قصة كلاسيكية، لكن لكل حكاية أكثر مما تبدو عليه. قبل أن تحكم على الكتاب من غلافه، عليك أن تقلب صفحاته. في إعادة سرد هذه الحكاية الكلاسيكية، تبدأ القصة من نهايتها وتعود إلى أحداثها السابقة. يحقق رئيس الشرطة غريزلي والمحقق بيل ستورك في اضطراب عائلي في كوخ الجدة، يتعلق بذات الرداء الأحمر التي تركل بحركات الكاراتيه، وذئب ساخر، ورجل غابات أحمق.

movies.title: The Polar Express
movies.summary: When a doubting young boy takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.
movies.rights: © 2004 Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.
movies.overviewAr: تحكي القصة عن فتى صغيرٍ تراوده الشكوك حول وجود سانتا كلوز، في عشية عيد الميلاد يجد البطل الصغير نفسه دون مقدمات على متن قطارٍ سحري متجه إلى القطب الشمالي حيث منزل سانتا كلوز. خلال تلك الرحلة المثيرة، يواجه الفتى الكثير من المفاجآت ويخوض العديد من المغامرات، يكتشف عن نفسه الكثير بواسطة تلك المغامرة المثيرة التي توضح له أن أكثر العجائب غرابة في الدنيا قابلة للحدوث ولكن فقط مع من يؤمنون بها.

movies.title: Casino Royale
movies.summary: Based on Ian Fleming's first 007 novel, James Bond must thwart a dangerous Russian spy who is funding global terrorists from winning a baccarat game worth millions. The 21st film in the most successful film series in cinematic history.

movies.plot: After earning a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007. Bond must defeat a private banker funding terrorists in a high-stakes game of poker at Casino Royale, in Montenegro.

movies.title: Pitch Perfect
movies.summary: Arriving at her new college, Beca (Anna Kendrick) finds herself not right for any clique but somehow is muscled into one that she never would have picked on her own: alongside mean girls, sweet girls and weird girls whose only thing in common is how good they sound when they sing together. When Beca leads this a cappella singing group out of their traditional arrangements and perfect harmonies into all-new mash-ups, they fight to climb their way to the top of college music competitions.
movies.rights: © 2012 Universal Pictures. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.
movies.overviewAr: تعرف طالبة جامعية بيكا أنها لا تريد أن تكون جزءًا من زمرة ، ولكن هذا هو بالضبط المكان الذي تجد فيه نفسها بعد وصولها إلى مدرستها الجديدة. اقتحم بيكا بين الفتيات اللئيمات والبنات اللطيفات والبنات الغريبة فقط ، تجد بيكا أن الشيء الوحيد المشترك بينهما هو مدى جودة الغناء معًا. إنها تأخذ نساء المجموعة من منطقة الراحة الخاصة بالترتيبات التقليدية إلى عالم من التوليفات التوافقية المذهلة في معركة للوصول إلى قمة مسابقات الموسيقى الجامعية.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movies.rawTitle: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movies.summary: There’s nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy’s Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, Professor Henry Jones Sr. (Sean Connery), in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail. movies.rights: TM & © 1989 Lucasfilm Ltd.  All Rights Reserved.  Used Under Authorization
movies.plot: In 1938, after his father goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, Indiana Jones finds himself up against the Nazis again to stop them from obtaining its powers.
movies.overviewAr: يخوض المغامر وعالم الآثار (إنديانا جونز) مغامرة مثيرة من أجل الحصول على الكأس المقدس الأسطوري، ويصحبه في تلك المغامرة والده، وهذا الكأس الأسطوري يمتلك قدرة نادرة على شفاء من يشرب منه، ويروى عن هذا الكأس أن من يشرب منه ينال الخلود، ولأجل هذا الغرض يحارب إنديانا العديد من الأشرار ﻷجل هذا الكأس.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
movies.rawTitle: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
movies.summary: The story of Coriolanus Snow, years before he would become the tyrannical President of Panem. He is young, very determined and though the Snow family has fallen on hard times, Coriolanus sees a chance for a change in his fortunes when he is chosen to be a mentor for the 10th Hunger Games only to have his elation dashed when he is assigned to mentor a girl tribute named Lucy Gray Baird from the impoverished District 12.
movies.rights: © 2024 Eagle Films
movies.plot: Coriolanus Snow mentors and develops feelings for the female District 12 tribute during the 10th Hunger Games.
movies.titleAr: ألعاب الجوع: أنشودة الطيور المغردة والثعابين
movies.overviewAr: قبل سنوات من تحوله إلى رئيس مستبد في بانيم، تدور الأحداث حول كوريولانوس سنو في سن الثامنة عشر، حيث يبحث عن المجد بعد اختياره ليكون مرشدًا لدورة ألعاب الجوع العاشرة.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
movies.summary: Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence), is rescued by the rebels and  brought to District 13 after she shatters the Hunger Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin (Julianne Moore) and Plutarch Heavensbee (Philip Seymour Hoffman), Katniss spreads her wings and becomes Mockingjay, the symbolic leader of the rebellion. But President Snow has his own plans for her—and her loved ones.
movies.rights: © 2014 Lions Gate Entertainment Inc. All rights reserved.
movies.plot: Katniss Everdeen is in District 13 after she shatters the games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.
movies.overviewAr: يرصد فيلم ( ألعاب الجوع: الطائر المحاكي - الجزء الأول) حياة كاتنيس إيفردين (جينيفر لورانس) حيث إنها على مضض ورغماً عنها أصبحت رمزًا لمنطقة بانيم وأيقونة للتمرد على الظلم والطغيان والاستبداد. تقود كاتنيس المتمردين والثوار في حرب حياة أو موت لتحدد مصير بانيم إلى الأبد. تتصاعد الأحداث ويمتد العنف لجميع المناطق. تجد كاتنيس نفسها في صراع داخلي جسيم حيث يتعين عليها تحديد من بإمكانها الوثوق به ومن لا يستحق ثقتها وعليها اتخاذ العديد من القرارات المصيرية.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
movies.summary: With the nation of Panem in a full-scale war, Katniss confronts President Snow [Donald Sutherland] in the final showdown. Teamed with a group of her closest friends – including Gale [Liam Hemsworth], Finnick [Sam Claflin] and Peeta [Josh Hutcherson] – Katniss goes off on a mission with the unit from District 13 as they risk their lives to liberate the citizens of Panem, and stage an assassination attempt on President Snow, who has become increasingly obsessed with destroying her. movies.rights: © 2015 Lions Gate Entertainment Inc. All rights reserved.

movies.overviewAr: بعد الأحداث الأخيرة في الجزء الأول من (Mockingjay)، وبعد أن صارت كاتنيس إيفردين (جينيفر لورانس) هي رمز الثورة في مواجهة نظام الكابيتول المستبد، ومع عودة بيتا ملارك (جوش هاتشرسون) إلى رفاقه، تدخل كاتنيس مع رفاقها الثوار في معركة ختامية ستكون هي الأصعب على اﻹطلاق ضد الكابيتول والرئيس (سنو).

movies.title: It Ends
movies.summary: From the producer of BACKROOMS comes a terrifying new horror. Four friends set out on a late-night drive, only to find themselves trapped on an endless road with no way out and something sinister waiting in the darkness.
movies.rights: © 2026 Front Row Filmed Entertainment
movies.plot: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.
movies.overviewAr: انطلقت مجموعة من الخريجين الجدد في رحلة ليلية بالسيارة بحثًا عن الطعام، آملين في قضاء وقت ممتع معًا قبل أن تفرقهم السبل. لكنهم وجدوا أنفسهم، عن طريق الخطأ، في طريق طويل لا نهاية له، ذي مسارين، محاط بأهوال لا تُوصف وقوى كونية تفوق فهمهم. مكتظين داخل سيارة جيب شيروكي، والأميال تمتد أمامهم بلا نهاية، يواجهون خيارًا صعبًا: إما تقبّل واقعهم الجديد أو الكفاح من أجل النجاة منه.

movies.title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
movies.rawTitle: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
movies.summary: A moment comes when you stop dreaming, start living and discover your destiny. For day dreamer Walter Mitty, that time is now. When his job, along with that of his coworker (Kristen Wiig) are threatened, Walter takes action and embarks on an incredible journey. Ben Stiller directs and co-stars in this inspiring story about an ordinary man who leaps into the extraordinary adventure that is life.
movies.rights: © 2013 Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation. All rights reserved.
movies.plot: When both he and a colleague are about to lose their job, Walter takes action by embarking on an adventure more extraordinary than anything he ever imagined.
movies.overviewAr: يبدأ مدير صور المجلات الخجول الذي يعيش الحياة بشكل غير مباشر من خلال أحلام اليقظة في مغامرة حقيقية عندما يختفي أحد الأشياء السلبية.

movies.title: The Shadow's Edge
movies.summary: A retired operative is drawn back into the shadows when a dangerous conspiracy from his past resurfaces, forcing him to protect those he loves while confronting enemies he thought were long gone. Starring Jackie Chan, 'Shadow’s Edge' blends high-octane action with signature humor in a thrilling story of loyalty, legacy, and redemption.
movies.rights: © 2026 Phars Film
movies.plot: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.
movies.overviewAr: يختفي طاقم من المجرمين العباقرة ومعهم مليارات، مهربين من القبض عليهم بتفوقهم على نظام المراقبة "عين السماء" الهائل. يائسين ومُتخاذلين، تستعين شرطة ماكاو بأسطورة - وونغ تاك تشونغ (جاكي شان)، خبير تعقب متقاعد. يُرشد وونغ الضابط المبتدئ هي تشيوغو (تشانغ زيفنغ)، ويُعيد بناء وحدة مراقبة النخبة. مهمتهم: تعقب "ملك الذئاب" المراوغ، فو لونغ شنغ (ليونغ كا فاي توني)، العقل المدبر وراء السرقة. مع اقتراب الشرطة، يُنصب اللصوص فخًا خاصًا بهم. تتصادم العقول، وتُختبر الولاءات، وتبدأ لعبة القط والفأر النهائية...

movies.title: Uptown Girls
movies.summary: Molly Gunn is the freewheeling daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of the Manhattan social scene. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job.  Molly becomes a nanny to precocious Ray Schleine, an "eight-year-old going on forty." Emotionally distant from her fast-paced A&R executive mother, Roma, Ray has grown up with a revolving door of nannies and little stability. Molly and Ray both feel painfully alone in the world, but as they try to make their new arrangement work, each discovers in the other a true friend.
movies.rights: © 2003 Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures Inc. All rights reserved.
movies.plot: A grown-up woman who kept her childish instincts and behavior starts working as the nanny of an 8-year-old girl who actually acts like an adult. But everything ends right-side up.
movies.overviewAr: تُجبر مولي غان، ابنة أسطورة موسيقى الروك الراحل، على العمل بعد أن يسرق مدير أعمالها أموالها. وبصفتها مربية لراي - ابنة مدير تنفيذي موسيقي ذكية ومُهمَلة في كثير من الأحيان - تتعلم مولي معنى أن تكون بالغة بينما تُعلّم راي كيف تعيش طفولتها

movies.title: Little Fockers
movies.summary: Greg Focker (Ben Stiller) has finally begun to earn the respect of his ex-CIA father-in-law, Jack Byrnes (Robert DeNiro) but one important test still lies ahead: will Greg prove that he has what it takes to be the family’s next “Godfocker” ... or will the circle of trust be broken for good? movies.rights: © 2010 DreamWorks Studios LLC and Universal Studios. All Rights Reserved.

movies.title: Michael
movies.summary: Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known. The film tells the story of Michael Jackson's life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to become the biggest entertainer in the world.
movies.rights: © 2026 Universal Studios. All Rights Reserved.

movies.title: Colony
movies.summary: When a deadly outbreak erupts inside a Seoul skyscraper, a group of strangers are trapped under lockdown with nowhere to run. As the infected grow more dangerous by the hour, survival becomes a brutal race against time. From the director of TRAIN TO BUSAN and PENINSULA.
movies.rights: © 2026 Front Row Filmed Entertainment

movies.title: The Drama
movies.summary: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple (Zendaya and Robert Pattinson) off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to 'I do.' movies.title: Code 3
movies.summary: Follows a paramedic that is so burnt-out by the job that he is forcing himself to resign, however, he first must embark on one last 24-hour shift to train his replacement.
movies.rights: © 2025 Front Row Filmed Entertainment
movies.plot: A burnt-out two-man paramedic crew and their student trainee ride-along embark on a 24-hour shift that exposes the funny, tragic, and broken aspects of the health-care system.
movies.overviewAr: مسعف منهك يحاول النجاة خلال آخر أربع وعشرين ساعة في عمله، بينما يدرّب مستجدًا.

movies.title: Rocky
movies.summary: Rocky Balboa is a struggling Philadelphia boxer who is scorned by his gym's owner, patronized by a loan shark and rebuffed by a shy 'plain-Jane', whose butcher brother keeps engineering a romantic match.  Rocky would have remained in this rut had not heavyweight champion Apollo Creed come up with the Bicentennial gimmick to give a chance for a 'nobody' to become a 'somebody'. movies.rights: © 1976 Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Studios, Inc. All Rights Reserved.

movies.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules

Raised on a sheltered island paradise, when an American pilot crashes on their shores and tells of a massive conflict raging in the outside world, Diana leaves her home, convinced she can stop the threat. Fighting alongside man in a war to end all wars, Diana will discover her full powers…and her true destiny.

movies.plot: When a pilot crashes and tells of conflict in the outside world, Diana, an Amazonian warrior in training, leaves home to fight a war, discovering her full powers and true destiny.
movies.overviewAr: قبل أن تصير المرأة الأعجوبة، تدربت (الأميرة ديانا)، أميرة الأمازون لتكون محاربة لا تُقهَر في جزيرة بارادايس واحتمت فيها إلى أن يهبط طيار أمريكي على الجزيرة؛ فتقرر ديانا الرحيل عن موطنها معه لتتعرف على حضارات وأماكن مختلفة ومحاربين، وتشارك في وقف الحروب المُدارة مختبرة قدراتها الحقيقية خلالها.

movies.title: Meet the Fockers
movies.summary: Domestic disaster looms for male nurse Greg Focker (Stiller) when his straight-laced, ex-CIA father-in-law (De Niro) asks to meet his wildly unconventional mum and dad (Streisand and Hoffman). It's family bonding gone hysterically haywire, in this must-see comedy!
movies.rights: © 2004 DreamWorks LLC and Universal Studios. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: All hell breaks loose when the Byrnes family meets the Focker family for the first time.

movies.title: Scream
movies.summary: Legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) re-invented and revitalized the slasher-horror genre with this funny, clever and scary first film in the hit franchise. After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans become the target of a masked killer.  As the body count begins, it's clear that the rules must be followed, and everyone's a suspect. David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Rose McGowan, Skeet Ulrich, and Drew Barrymore star in this semi-satire, all-scares first installment.
movies.rights: © 1996 Miramax, LLC. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.
movies.overviewAr: بعد عام من مقتل والدتها، تجد مراهقة نفسها هدفًا لقاتل مقنّع يطاردها هي وأصدقاءها، مستخدمًا قواعد أفلام الرعب جزءًا من لعبته الدموية، بينما تتسع دائرة المشتبه بهم ولا يعرف أحد من يختبئ خلف القناع.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon
movies.summary: This Academy Award®-nominated DreamWorks Animation film rolls fire-breathing action, epic adventure and big laughs into a captivating, fun and original story. Hiccup is a young Viking who defies tradition and befriends one of his deadliest foes – a ferocious dragon he calls Toothless. Together, the unlikely heroes fight against the odds to save both their worlds in this wonderful, feel-good hit.
movies.rights: © 2010 Dreamworks Animation
movies.plot: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.
movies.overviewAr: (هيكاب) فتى مراهق من الفايكنج، يحاول أن يصبح فردا من الفايكنج عن طريق قتل تنين، وعندما ينجح في اصطياد أقوى هذه الأنواع ويُدعى (غضب الليل) يفشل في إتمام مهمة القتل لذلك يخفي سر التنين، ويحاول مساعدته على الطياران، وخلال هذه الفترة يتعلم (هيكاب) الكثير عن التنانين، ويكتشف أنها حيوانات أليفة يمكن ترويضها.  تتازم الأحداث عندما يكتشف سر التنين و يحاول الفايكنج القضاء على وكر التانيين.

movies.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
movies.summary: Jack Reacher returns to enforce his bold brand of justice in the action-packed sequel based on Lee Child’s best-selling Jack Reacher series. When Army Major Susan Turner is framed for treason, Reacher discovers she’s the target of a massive government conspiracy. With help from Turner and a mysterious new ally, Reacher risks everything to take down a powerful organization that will stop at nothing to protect its secrets.
movies.rights: © 2016 Paramount Pictures. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: Investigator Jack Reacher goes on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.
movies.overviewAr: بعد عودته إلى وحدته العسكرية، يجد جاك ريتشر (توم كروز) نفسه متهمًا بدون ذنب في جريمة قتل لشاب في السادسة عشر من عمره، ويصير هاربًا من العدالة في نظر الجميع، ويحاول جاك أن يبريء ساحته من خلال الكشف عن مؤامرة حكومية كبرى، وخلال كل ذلك يكتشف جاك سرًا من الماضي قد يغير حياته للأبد.

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.summary: Average teenager Peter Parker is transformed into an extraordinary super hero after he is accidentally bitten by a radioactive spider. When his beloved uncle is savagely murdered during a robbery, young Peter vows to use his powers to avenge his death. Deeming himself "Spider-Man ," he sets about ridding the streets of crime, bringing him into conflict with malevolent super-villain "Green Goblin."

movies.title: Panic Room
movies.summary: Newly divorced Meg Altman (Jodie Foster) and her young daughter Sarah (Kristen Stewart) move into a New York brownstone equipped with a panic room; a hidden chamber built as a sanctuary in the event of unwanted "visitors," unaware of how soon they will need it. When their home is the target of a seamless late-night break-in, Meg and Sarah take a stand from the sanctuary of the panic room, playing a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with three intruders: Burnham (Forest Whitaker), Raoul (Dwight Yoakam) and Junior (Jared Leto), during a brutal home invasion. But mother and daughter are unaware of two important facts: first, that Burnham himself is a designer and builder of safe rooms; and second, that the room itself is their target . . . and the interlopers will stop at nothing to get inside.
movies.rights: © 2002 Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. All Rights Reserved.

movies.title: Jack Reacher
movies.summary: From The New York Times bestselling author Lee Child comes one of the most compelling heroes to step from novel to screen - ex-military investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise). When a gunman takes five lives with six shots, all evidence points to the suspect in custody. On interrogation, the suspect offers up a single note: Get Jack Reacher! So begins an extraordinary chase for the truth, pitting Jack Reacher against an unexpected enemy, with a skill for violence and a secret to keep.
movies.rights: © 2012 Paramount Pictures Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: Jack Reacher, a homicide investigator, digs deeper into a case involving a trained military sniper responsible for a mass shooting.
movies.overviewAr: تدور قصة الفيلم حول قناص محترف يقتل خمسة أشخاص بعد استخدامه لست طلقات، فتبدأ الشرطة في البحث عن الجاني، وتقبض على أحد الأشخاص الذي ينصحهم بالاستعانة بـ، الضابط السابق في القوات المسلحة، والذي يبدأ في التحقيق بالجريمة في إطار تشويقي غامض.

movies.title: Back to the Future Part II
movies.rawTitle: Back to the Future Part II
movies.summary: Brace yourself – as the most spectacular history-altering adventure of all time continues in the hit sequel that proves lightning can strike twice! Marty and Doc (Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd) have barely recovered from their first time-travelling adventure when they launch themselves once more into the space-time continuum. But this time around, their attempt to fine-tune the future in the year 2015 creates an outlandish, alternate 1985 Hill Valley where Biff Tannen is rich, powerful and… Marty’s dad! Now, their only chance to fix the present is by going back to 1955 all over again. But can Doc and Marty patch up the past without igniting a universe-shredding time paradox? Executive Producer Steven Spielberg and Director Robert Zemeckis rev up another round of wondrously inventive, comically super-charged action in BACK TO THE FUTURE PART II!
movies.rights: © 1989 Universal Studios. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: After visiting 2015, Marty McFly must repeat his visit to 1955 to prevent disastrous changes to 1985, without interfering with his first trip.
movies.overviewAr: تدور أحداث الجزء الثاني من الفيلم حول زيارة مارتي لعام 1955 مرة أخري عن طريق آلة الزمن، ولكن مهمته هذه المرة منع تغييرات كارثية لعام 1985، وذلك دون تدخل أحد معه في رحلته.

movies.title: Aftersun
movies.summary:
From producer Barry Jenkins (Moonlight, If Beale Street Could Talk) comes a film that is "a sharply moving exploration of the bond between parent and child" (Variety) which garnered Paul Mescal (Gladiator 2, Normal People) a 2023 Academy Award Nomination for "Best Actor".

Years after their last vacation, Sophie reflects on the rare time spent with her loving, idealistic father, attempting to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.
movies.rights: © 2023 Front Row Filmed Entertainment
movies.plot: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories real and imagined fill the gaps between as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.
movies.overviewAr: تتأمل صوفي في الفرح المشترك والحزن الخاص لعطلة أخذتها مع والدها قبل عشرين عاما. تملأ الذكريات الحقيقية والمتخيلة الفجوات بين لقطات ميني دف وهي تحاول التوفيق بين الأب الذي تعرفه والرجل الذي لم تعرفه.

movies.title: The Smashing Machine
movies.summary: Based on a true story, Dwayne Johnson stars as Mark Kerr, a pioneering MMA fighter whose raw power makes him one of the most feared men in the sport. But as his fame grows, battles with addiction and a turbulent relationship with his partner Dawn (Emily Blunt) threaten to unravel everything he has fought for, forcing him to confront his greatest opponent yet: himself.
movies.rights: © 2025 Front Row Filmed Entertainment
movies.plot: The story of mixed-martial arts and UFC champion, Mark Kerr.
movies.overviewAr: في أواخر التسعينيات، كان مارك كير، المقاتل الصاعد في فنون القتال المختلطة، يطمح لأن يصبح أعظم مقاتل في العالم. ومع ذلك، كان عليه أيضاً أن يكافح إدمانه على المواد الأفيونية وعلاقته المتوترة مع صديقته داون.

movies.title: Dead Silence
movies.summary: You Scream. You Die. Dare to unlock the deadly curse of Mary Shaw… From the writers and director of Saw comes a new thriller of relentless terror! Ever since Mary Shaw was hunted down and killed, the small town of Ravens Fair has been haunted by horrific deaths. When a local's wife is brutally murdered, he returns home to unravel the terrifying legend of Mary Shaw and the reason why when you see her, you should never, ever scream.
movies.rights: © 2007 Universal Studios. All Rights Reserved.
movies.plot: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen returns to his haunted hometown of Ravens Fair to find answers. His investigation leads him to the ghost of a ventriloquist named Mary Shaw who seems to have ties to his entire family tree
movies.overviewAr: بعد مقتل زوجته بطريقة مروعة إثر وصول طرد غامض يحوي دمية متكلم من البطن، يعود شاب إلى بلدته بحثًا عن إجابات، فيكتشف أن الجريمة قد ترتبط بأسطورة قديمة عن فنانة عرائس قُتلت في الماضي.
